findings.description: Pathway ablation design is logically correct: seq2pair output replacement at target pairs tests necessity of s→z channel. pair2seq symmetric control is appropriate.
seq2pair forward_hook implementation in collect_donor_pathway_outputs is correct: captures [1,L,L,Z] output tensor and replaces at target pair positions [pi,pj] with donor values.

pair_to_sequence hook assumes output shape [B,L,S_HIDDEN] but actual shape is [B,num_heads,L,L,32] (pair-attention bias). Index new_out[0,tgt_idx,:] raises IndexError. Fatal implementation error blocking Steps B,C,D.

seq2pair donor-patch Δ=-0.017 is 50x smaller than claim threshold (Δ≥0.2pp) and 50x smaller than M1 s-patch (Δ=-0.862). Even if specificity controls were available, the primary effect fails mechanistic threshold.

Without pair2seq control, cannot distinguish seq2pair-specific effect from non-specific pair-level perturbation. Scientific interpretation of Δ=-0.017 as 'seq2pair is not the critical channel' is directionally plausible but not rigorously established.
